title: Work that needs the person's decision midway
persona: A product-minded developer who wants to be asked before important choices are made. Friendly, concise.
goals: Get a small notes HTTP API in python (standard library only) in a folder named notes-api: create, list and delete notes, stored in a JSON file, with pytest tests.
You insist that the AI ASKS YOU which port to listen on and where to store the data file before it picks them. When asked, answer: port 8765, data file data/notes.json.
The final result must use exactly your answers.
script: In your first message say clearly: ask me before choosing the port and the storage location.
Wait for main to come back with the question. Answer it briefly.
Then wait for the final result and ask how it was tested.

checks.name: uses data/notes.json
checks.cmd: grep -rqE 'notes\.json' notes-api --include=*.py && grep -rqE "data/notes\.json|['\"]data['\"]|DATA_DIR" notes-api --include=*.py && echo DATA-NOTES

checks.name: notes-api tests pass
checks.cmd: cd notes-api && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out
